description.value: Garibaldi Park is a vast provincial park in the heart of the Coast Mountains, centred on the 2,678 m peak of Mount Garibaldi and spanning diverse terrain from glacial lakes to alpine meadows. It offers over 90 km of established hiking trails across multiple backcountry zones including Garibaldi Lake, Black Tusk, Cheakamus Lake, and Diamond Head. A day-use pass is required for entry, and the access roads are shared with cyclists and wildlife, making it a landmark stop along the Sea to Sky corridor.
